_sources: Chain id + CRE forwarders: ARCHITECTURE R1, R14. WMON, Pyth, 'no Chainlink', 'no AUSD': PHASES decision 10 (verified 29 Sep). Everything else null = VERIFY before use.
_owner: Testnet owner = the deployer (ownerIsDeployer); DeployPulse writes the resolved address into deployments/10143.json. Mainnet (143) will be the 2-of-3 Safe in Phase 5; the script refuses a deployer owner on 143.

tokens._AUSD: No AUSD on testnet (decision 10): DeployPulse deploys MockERC20 'tAUSD' (6 dp)

pyth._contract: PHASES decision 10: exists on testnet but the MON/USD feed is ~75 min stale (no sponsored push) => the keeper must push Hermes updates (Pyth API key = CP1 blocker)
pyth._monUsdFeedId: Pyth feed ids are chain-independent; VERIFY the feed is pushed on testnet

chainlink._monUsd: No Chainlink feeds on testnet (decision 10): adapter runs with secondary = address(0)

kuru._kuru: VERIFY: Kuru testnet deployment (docs.kuru.io); vault hedger uses MockKuruHedger until then

params._note: WAD values are decimal strings. Sources: MATH_SPEC §1.3 (funding), §3.3 (risk), §5.3 (vault), §6 (swaps); TEAM_PLAN §7 (launch caps).

swap._maturity: unix seconds, set at deploy: 30 days after listing (MATH_SPEC §6.1)

params._maxPositionSize: A's choice (not in specs): 10% of the per-side OI cap, same ratio as the perp

oracle._maxStalenessSec: 10 s assumes keeper Hermes pushes (R12); 60 s without a Pyth API key (R24). WS-03 owns
oracle._maxDeviationWad: 2% (A's choice, WS-03): Pyth vs Chainlink guard tolerance on mainnet; Chainlink MON/USD moves minutes apart (R11), so a tighter band would trip in fast markets. Unused on testnet (no Chainlink; TestnetKeeperOracle reports it only). VERIFY vs Chainlink's deviation threshold at data.chain.link before mainnet
oracle._kind: 'keeper-fed' (TestnetKeeperOracle fed by the keeper from mainnet Pyth MON/USD, fallback Hyperliquid) until a Pyth Hermes API key exists (R24; testnet Pyth MON/USD verified ~5.4 h stale on 30 Sep). With a key: 'pyth' (PythChainlinkOracleAdapter, secondary = address(0) since there is no Chainlink on testnet) + maxStalenessSec 10 and keeper Hermes pushes; the CH's oracle is immutable, so switching means redeploying the market.
oracle._keeperFedMaxStalenessSec: 60 s = R24's no-key value: source cadence (mainnet sponsored Pyth 10–30 s) + keeper heartbeat 10 s + inclusion; beyond it the CH freezes funding and blocks increases (MATH_SPEC §1.6)

_rpc: Public testnet RPC https://testnet-rpc.monad.xyz (QuickNode, 50 rps; 25 rps eth_call/estimateGas) per docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/testnet (ARCHITECTURE R29). Scripts still read MONAD_TESTNET_RPC_URL from .env.

demoMarket._note: TEST MARKET (own OB + CH + keeper-fed TestnetKeeperOracle, shared IF), used only for the crash/liquidation demo: real Pyth can't be moved on demand, and the main market's price/params are never forced (Phase 3 step 3).
